content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Stock photos

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete, self-owned digital commerce stack. It’s not a plugin or a third-party service. It’s a combination of tools that you control entirely. For stock photo creators in Nigeria, this means no reliance on Stripe, PayPal, or any platform that can shut you out. The Edge Commerce Stack uses Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. Every component is selected for its reliability and your ownership. You’re not renting space on someone else’s platform. You’re building on infrastructure that’s yours. This isn’t just a technical choice—it’s a strategic one. It ensures that your business can operate regardless of geopolitical or financial restrictions. It’s commerce infrastructure designed for permanence, not convenience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how it works: Your stock photos are hosted on Cloudflare Pages, a free and globally distributed platform. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers, which processes orders and triggers actions without servers. Orders are stored in Supabase, a scalable database that you control. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. Once payment is confirmed on-chain, a webhook automatically delivers the product. This system is modular—each component is independent but works together seamlessly. There’s no single point of failure. No platform can shut you down. And because it’s all open-source, you can inspect, modify, or replace any part. This architecture isn’t just about selling stock photos—it’s about building a commerce system that’s as resilient as your creativity.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators who’ve been locked out of conventional payment systems. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or any region where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, this is for you. It’s for creators selling stock photos, templates, presets, or any digital product. It’s for those who’ve lost sales because buyers couldn’t pay. It’s for those who’ve been rejected by platforms for no clear reason. The Edge Commerce Stack is your response. It’s not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative. It’s for creators who want to own their infrastructure, not rent it. It’s for those who value permanence over convenience. If you’re tired of being at the mercy of platforms, this is how you take control.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure means you own every piece of your stack—no platforms, no subscriptions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the Edge Commerce Stack is chosen for its reliability and your ownership. Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront and product pages for free. Cloudflare Workers handles backend logic without servers, ensuring scalability. Supabase stores order data in a database you control. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. Cloudflare R2 delivers files securely and instantly. These tools aren’t just integrated—they’re configured to work together out of the box. For example, when a payment is confirmed on-chain, NOWPayments triggers a webhook that delivers the stock photo via Cloudflare R2. This isn’t a collection of tools—it’s a system. And because you own every piece, you’re not dependent on any platform. This is how you build a commerce stack that’s as sovereign as your business.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying the Edge Commerce Stack starts with understanding your needs. Do you have 5 products or 50? Are your buyers using BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees? Once you know, the deployment is straightforward. COREMERCH handles the setup in 48 hours, loading your products, configuring SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability, and testing end-to-end. You get lifetime access to the infrastructure. No subscriptions. No hidden fees. After deployment, you own it. You can modify it, scale it, or even move it. This isn’t a service—it’s a handover. If you’re ready to stop renting and start owning, the Edge Commerce Stack is your next step. It’s not just about selling stock photos—it’s about building a commerce system that’s as permanent as your work.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed and configured by COREMERCH. You don’t need to write code or manage servers. After deployment, you own the infrastructure and can modify it if needed.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. We recommend BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees under $0.10. Your buyers can pay with any of these, and you receive payments instantly.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?
No. The Edge Commerce Stack is a one-time purchase. There are no subscriptions or hidden fees. You own the infrastructure after deployment, and all tools used are free or low-cost.
Can I scale this for more products?
Yes. The stack is designed to scale. You can add more products, modify the backend logic, or expand storage as needed. It’s your infrastructure—you control it.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments is a reliable service, but if it fails, you can replace it with another crypto payment processor. The stack is modular, so you’re not locked into any single component.
